metadata.description: Claude Code / Cowork plugins by Tomoki Ishimine, starting with print3d-modeler for designing print-ready 3D models through conversation.

plugins.name: print3d-modeler
plugins.description: Design 3D models through conversation in Python (build123d), check them in a 3D viewer with independent printability and requirements reviews, and export print-ready STL / 3MF for FDM 3D printers.
